notes: Most testing is automated: tests/run_live.py runs every fixture with deslop, deslop twice, and plain Claude; tests/run_tests.py scores them (lint score, high hits, facts.py, similarity to the human originals). These prompts are the hand-graded cases on top of that, in skill-creator format.

evals.expected_output: SCORE before and after, NEEDS YOUR INPUT list, CLEAN TEXT, grouped CHANGES, FACTS line.
expectations: lint.py on the clean text reports 0 high hits
8,000, 21,000, 162%, HubSpot, Acme Retail and 2020 – 2024 all appear unchanged
No new number, tool or employer appears that was not in the input
Cliches (results-driven, proven track record, passionate about) are gone
At least one [NEEDS SPECIFIC: ...] marker where a result was vague
Output follows the format in SKILL.md, score line first

evals.expected_output: Context guessed as report; very few changes; at most em dashes replaced.
expectations: States the guessed context in one line
At least 85% of words unchanged (word-level similarity)
No [NEEDS SPECIFIC] markers, or at most one
The three-item lists and bold labels are kept or changed only lightly

evals.expected_output: Prose cleaned, every code block identical.
expectations: facts.py reports code_blocks.changed = false
Every inline code span and command is unchanged
Package and function names are unchanged

evals.prompt:
deslop context=social mode=embedded

The text is in tests/fixtures/ai/a15-social-manager-classic.md
evals.expected_output: Only the CLEAN TEXT and NEEDS YOUR INPUT blocks.
expectations: Reply contains only the two blocks, nothing before or after
No emoji, at most 3 hashtags
First person and the author's opinions are kept

evals.prompt:
/deslop report keep em dashes

The text is in tests/fixtures/ai/a19-report-freight-facts.md
evals.expected_output: Corporate filler removed, every fact identical, em dashes untouched.
expectations: facts.py: no lost or added numbers or URLs
Marta Lindqvist, Maersk, DB Schenker, Rotterdam and Antwerp all appear
'state-of-the-art', 'marks an exciting new chapter' and the thank-you closer are gone
Any em dash in the input is still there

evals.prompt:
/deslop mode=rewrite report

This was written by AI. Make it read like a person wrote it. The text is in tests/fixtures/ai/a19-report-freight-facts.md
evals.expected_output: Full output format. Stiff sentences rewritten whole in plain words, every fact kept.
expectations: facts.py reports no lost or added number, URL or code
No new number, name or tool appears that was not in the input
Most paragraphs are reworded, not just trimmed
Section order is unchanged
Vague claims get a [NEEDS SPECIFIC: ...] marker or are cut, never filled with a guess
